title: Instagram — Global Express XRS shrink-the-map reel
body:
The Global Express XRS was built to erase the layover. Ultra-long-range, large cabin, and the coverage that matters where it counts: engines on Rolls-Royce Corporate Care and the APU on MSP Gold.

This 2005 airframe pairs true intercontinental legs with a maintenance story you can defend at resale. When the mission is 'get there in one hop, rested,' this is the shape it takes.

Full spec and status reports on request.
